title: Cooking Energy Transition in Nepal: Trend Review
abstract: Clean-cooking energy is key to meeting climate-mitigation goals and a range of development objectives, especially for improving the well-being of women and children. Inefficient burning of solid biomass for cooking releases household air pollution that is hazardous to health, while putting pressure on forest resources. This paper provides an overview of the household-cooking-energy transition in Nepal to date. Despite numerous efforts by the government and other actors to speed this transition, energy data spanning the years 2000–18 reveal that ~69% of households nationwide still rely on solid fuels for cooking today. The proportion of solid-fuel users is especially high in rural regions, reaching >80%. Moreover, if the current rate of progress is not accelerated, the use of solid fuels will remain high even in 2030, preventing the achievement of Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 7. Cooking-fuel choices are heavily constrained by accessibility, demographic and socio-economic factors. Thus, this paper recommends that evidence-based and integrated policies and strategies be urgently deployed to foster a more effective and rapid transition towards clean energy, which is critical to achieving SDG 7.
abstract_zh: 清洁烹饪能源是实现气候减缓目标以及一系列发展目标的关键，尤其对改善妇女和儿童的福祉至关重要。低效燃烧固体生物质用于烹饪会释放有害健康的家庭空气污染，同时加大了对森林资源的压力。本文概述了迄今为止尼泊尔家庭烹饪能源转型的情况。尽管政府及其他各方为加速这一转型做出了诸多努力，但涵盖2000至2018年的能源数据显示，全国约69%的家庭目前仍依赖固体燃料烹饪。在农村地区，使用固体燃料的家庭比例尤其高，超过80%。此外，如果当前的进展速度不加快，即使到2030年，固体燃料的使用率仍将居高不下，从而无法实现可持续发展目标（SDG）7。烹饪燃料的选择在很大程度上受到可获得性、人口和社会经济因素的制约。因此，本文建议迅速部署基于证据、综合性的政策与战略，以推动更有效、更快速地向清洁能源转型，这对实现可持续发展目标7至关重要。

title: The benefits of action to reduce household air pollution (BAR-HAP) model: A new decision support tool for energy and health sector decision-makers
abstract: Cooking with polluting and inefficient fuels and technologies is responsible for a large set of global harms, ranging from health and time losses among the billions of people who are energy poor, to environmental degradation at a regional and global scale. This paper presents a new decision-support model–the BAR-HAP Tool–that is aimed at guiding planning of policy interventions to accelerate transitions towards cleaner cooking fuels and technologies. The conceptual model behind BAR-HAP lies in a framework of costs and benefits that is holistic and comprehensive, allows consideration of multiple policy interventions (subsidies, financing, bans, and behavior change communication), and realistically accounts for partial adoption and use of improved cooking technology. It incorporates evidence from recent efforts to characterize the relevant set of parameters that determine those costs and benefits, including those related to intervention effectiveness. Practical aspects of the tool were modified based on feedback from a pilot testing workshop with multisectoral users in Nepal. To demonstrate the functionality of the BAR-HAP tool, we present illustrative calculations related to several cooking transitions in the context of Nepal. In accounting for the multifaceted nature of the issue of household air pollution, the BAR-HAP model is expected to facilitate cross-sector dialogue and problem-solving to address this major health, environment and development challenge.
abstract_zh: 使用污染性且低效的燃料和技术烹饪，会造成一系列全球性危害，从能源贫困的数十亿人口所遭受的健康损害和时间损失，到区域和全球范围的环境退化。本文提出了一种新的决策支持模型——BAR-HAP工具，旨在指导政策干预的规划，以加速向更清洁的烹饪燃料和技术转型。BAR-HAP背后的概念模型基于一个全面、整体的成本收益框架，允许考虑多种政策干预（包括补贴、融资、禁令和行为改变宣传），并切实考虑改良烹饪技术的部分采纳与使用情况。模型纳入了近期研究中用于刻画决定这些成本与收益的一系列参数的证据，包括与干预有效性相关的参数。该工具的实际操作细节根据在尼泊尔与多部门用户开展的试点测试研讨会的反馈进行了修改。为展示BAR-HAP工具的功能，我们给出了在尼泊尔若干烹饪转型情境下的示意性计算。鉴于家庭空气污染问题的多面性，BAR-HAP模型有望促进跨部门对话与问题解决，以应对这一重大的健康、环境与发展挑战。

title: Do decentralized community treatment plants provide better water? Evidence from Andhra Pradesh
abstract: Highly advanced, community-level drinking water treatment facilities are increasingly seen as water supply solutions in locations where piped in-house water systems are nonexistent or unreliable. These systems utilize combined technologies, such as advanced filtration plus ultraviolet disinfection or reverse osmosis, which are known to be highly effective for the removal of pathogens and other water contaminants. Yet there is a paucity of rigorous evidence on whether the community-level treatment model delivers water quality, health, or other benefits to households that source water from them. This paper utilizes a quasi-experimental approach that combines construction of counterfactual groups of villages and households and a difference-in-difference methodology to examine such impacts. We find low rates of sourcing water from the facilities (~10%), and little evidence of benefits among households living in villages receiving a community water system (CWS). Particularly among users of the CWS, we also observe short-term increases in the number of drinking water sources used and in monthly expenses on drinking water combined with decreases in in-house water treatment, and higher reported rates of diarrheal diseases among children. In the longer term, as the CWS model spread throughout the region, we observe that most of the differences between households in treated and control communities fade away. These findings suggest that caution and additional scrutiny is warranted before concluding that such systems provide safer water to households in communities facing drinking water quality problems.
abstract_zh: 高度先进的社区级饮用水处理设施，在没有或无法可靠获得管道入户供水系统的地方，正日益被视为供水解决方案。这些系统采用组合技术，例如先进过滤加紫外线消毒或反渗透，已知其对去除病原体和其他水体污染物非常有效。然而，关于社区级处理模式是否能为从中取水的家庭带来水质、健康或其他益处，严谨的证据仍然匮乏。本文采用一种准实验方法，结合构建反事实的村庄和家庭对照组，以及双重差分方法来考察此类影响。我们发现，从这些设施取水的比例很低（约10%），且在接受社区供水系统（CWS）的村庄中，家庭几乎没有获得益处的证据。特别是在CWS的用户中，我们还观察到饮用水水源使用数量和饮用水月支出的短期增加，同时室内水处理减少，并且儿童腹泻疾病的自我报告发生率更高。从长期来看，随着CWS模式在该地区推广，我们观察到处理组与对照组社区家庭之间的大部分差异逐渐消失。这些发现表明，在断定此类系统能为面临饮用水质量问题的社区家庭提供更安全的水之前，需要保持谨慎并进行更多审查。

title: Review of the State of the Art in Analysis of the Economics of Water Resources Infrastructure
venue: Oxford Research Encyclopedia of Environmental Science
abstract:
Water resources represent an essential input to most human activities, but harnessing them requires significant infrastructure. Such water control allows populations to cope with stochastic water availability, preserving uses during droughts while protecting against the ravages of floods. Economic analysis is particularly valuable for helping to guide infrastructure investment choices, and for comparing the relative value of so called hard and soft (noninfrastructure) approaches to water management.
The historical evolution of the tools for conducting such economic analysis is considered. Given the multimillennial history of human reliance on water infrastructure, it may be surprising that economic assessments of its value are a relatively recent development. Owing to the need to justify the rapid deployment of major public-sector financing outlays for water infrastructure in the early 20th century, government agencies in the United States—the Army Corps of Engineers and the Bureau of Reclamation—were early pioneers in developing these applications. Their work faced numerous technical challenges, first addressed in the drafting of the cost-benefit norms of the “Green Book.” Subsequent methodological innovation then worked to address a suite of challenges related to nonmarket uses of water, stochastic hydrology, water systems interdependencies, the social opportunity cost of capital, and impacts on secondary markets, as well as endogenous sociocultural feedbacks. The improved methods that have emerged have now been applied extensively around the world, with applications increasingly focused on the Global South where the best infrastructure development opportunities remain today.
The dominant tools for carrying out such economic analyses are simulation or optimization hydroeconomic models (HEM), but there are also other options: economy wide water-economy models (WEMs), sociohydrological models (SHMs), spreadsheet-based partial equilibrium cost-benefit models, and others. Each of these has different strengths and weaknesses. Notable innovations are also discussed. For HEMs, these include stochastic, fuzz, and robust optimization, respectively, as well as co-integration with models of other sectors (e.g., energy systems models). Recent cutting-edge work with WEMs and spreadsheet-based CBA models, meanwhile, has focused on linking these tools with spatially resolved HEMs. SHMs have only seen limited application to infrastructure valuation problems but have been useful for illuminating the paradox of flood management infrastructure increasing the incidence and severity of flood damages, and for explaining the co-evolution of water-based development and environmental concerns, which ironically then devalues the original infrastructure. Other notable innovations are apparent in multicriteria decision analysis, and in game-theoretic modeling of noncooperative water institutions.
These advances notwithstanding, several issues continue to challenge accurate and helpful economic appraisal of water infrastructure and should be the subject of future investigations in this domain. These include better assessment of environmental and distributional impacts, incorporation of empirically based representations of costs and benefits, and greater attention to the opportunity costs of infrastructure. Existing tools are well evolved from those of a few decades ago, supported by enhancements in scientific understanding and computational power. Yet, they do appear to systematically produce inflated estimations of the net benefits of water infrastructure. Tackling existing shortcomings will require continued interdisciplinary collaboration between economists and scholars from other disciplines, to allow leveraging of new theoretical insights, empirical data analyses, and modeling innovations.
abstract_zh:
水资源是大多数人类活动不可或缺的投入，但利用水资源需要大量基础设施。这类水利控制使人口能够应对随机变化的水可得性，在干旱期保障用水，同时抵御洪水的破坏。经济分析对于指导基础设施投资选择，以及比较所谓的硬性（工程性）与软性（非工程性）水资源管理方法的相对价值，尤为宝贵。
本文考察了开展此类经济分析工具的历史演变。鉴于人类依赖水利基础设施已有数千年之久，人们或许会惊讶地发现，对其价值的经济评估却是较为晚近的发展。由于20世纪初需要为大规模的公共部门水利基础设施融资提供正当性，美国的政府机构——陆军工程兵团与垦务局——成为发展这些应用的早期先驱。他们的工作面临诸多技术挑战，这些挑战首先在“绿皮书”的成本收益规范中得到了处理。随后的方法创新致力于应对一系列挑战，包括非市场用水、随机水文、水系统相互依存、资本的社会机会成本，以及对二级市场的影响，还有内生的社会文化反馈。已出现的改进方法已在全球范围内得到广泛应用，其应用日益集中于全球南方，那里仍蕴藏着最佳的基础设施发展机遇。
目前开展此类经济分析的主要工具是模拟或优化型水文经济模型（HEM），此外还有其他选择：全经济体水—经济模型（WEM）、社会水文模型（SHM）、基于电子表格的局部均衡成本收益模型等。每种模型各有优劣。文中还讨论了一些值得注意的创新。就HEM而言，这些创新分别包括随机优化、模糊优化和稳健优化，以及与其他部门模型（如能源系统模型）的协同整合。近期针对WEM和基于电子表格的成本收益模型的前沿工作，则主要聚焦于将这些工具与空间分辨的HEM相连接。SHM在基础设施价值评估问题上的应用仍较为有限，但在揭示洪水管理基础设施反而增加洪灾发生率和严重程度这一悖论，以及解释水利开发与环境关切的共同演化方面发挥了作用，而后者讽刺性地导致了原有基础设施的价值贬损。其他值得注意的创新还体现在多准则决策分析，以及非合作水制度的博弈论建模中。
尽管取得了这些进展，仍有若干问题持续挑战着对水利基础设施进行准确且有益的经济评估，它们应成为该领域未来研究的课题。这些问题包括：更好地评估环境与分配影响，纳入基于经验的成本与收益表征，以及更加关注基础设施的机会成本。与几十年前相比，现有工具已得到充分发展，科学认识与计算能力的提升也为其提供了支持。然而，它们似乎系统性地高估了水利基础设施的净效益。要解决现有的不足，将需要经济学家与其他学科学者之间持续的跨学科合作，以便借助新的理论洞见、实证数据分析和建模创新。

title: Do improved cookstoves save time and improve gender outcomes? Evidence from six developing countries
abstract: Three billion people around the world lack access to affordable and reliable clean cooking energy. The case for clean energy has largely been built around health and or environmental benefits, neglecting potentially sizeable benefit(s): when households have clean energy, they can save time and reduce drudgery. Clean energy can reduce poverty. But how large are time savings from the adoption and use of improved cookstoves (ICS)? Do these benefits accrue especially to women? To answer these questions, we develop a conceptual framework based on household production, and then employ two complementary empirical methods. First, we review the impact evaluation literature that estimates time savings from use of various ICS. Second, we conduct multivariable regression analysis of Multi-Tier Framework (MTF) data from six countries to estimate the impacts of ICS on time spent on cooking. The review and econometric estimation offer consistent evidence that ICS can help households save time, but the estimated savings vary across locations, technologies, and study methods. Time savings (i) are consistent across both rural and urban areas, (ii) are greatest for fuel collection and preparation (rather than cooking), (iii) accrue to both women and men, and (iv) are highest for more advanced technologies and fuels (like electricity, LPG, and biogas). Overall, our pooled econometric estimates suggest that ICS use leads households to save about 34 min per day. Our estimate is lower than the average of estimates in the literature (68 min/day), but not so different from the average among a lower cluster of estimates (29 min/day). While our work illuminates shortcomings inherent in current research on this topic, our results constitute an important first step towards advancing the practice of quantification of time savings from household energy interventions.
abstract_zh: 全世界有三十亿人无法获得负担得起且可靠的清洁烹饪能源。清洁能源的论证在很大程度上是围绕健康和/或环境效益构建的，而忽视了可能相当可观的其他效益：当家庭拥有清洁能源时，可以节省时间、减轻繁重的家务劳动。清洁能源能够减少贫困。但是，采用和使用改良炉灶（ICS）所节省的时间有多大？这些效益是否尤其惠及女性？为回答这些问题，我们基于家庭生产理论构建了一个概念框架，然后采用两种互补的实证方法。第一，我们回顾了估计使用各种ICS所节省时间的影响评估文献。第二，我们对来自六个国家的多层级框架（MTF）数据进行了多变量回归分析，以估计ICS对烹饪时间的影响。综述与计量估计均一致表明，ICS能够帮助家庭节省时间，但估计的节省量因地点、技术和研究方法而异。时间节省（i）在农村和城市地区都一致存在，（ii）在燃料收集与准备（而非烹饪本身）方面最为显著，（iii）对女性和男性均有益，并且（iv）在更先进的技术和燃料（如电力、液化石油气和沼气）下最高。总体而言，我们的汇总计量估计表明，使用ICS可使家庭每天节省约34分钟。我们的估计低于文献中估计值的平均水平（每天68分钟），但与较低一组估计值的平均水平（每天29分钟）相差不大。尽管我们的工作揭示了当前该主题研究中固有的不足，但我们的结果构成了推进家庭能源干预时间节省量化实践的重要第一步。

Adoption and impacts of improved biomass cookstoves in rural Rajasthan
abstract: Biomass-burning improved cookstoves (ICS) are often seen as a promising intermediate technology solution along the path of household transition to cleaner cooking. This study reports on the results of an experimental evaluation of a carbon finance-enabled program conducted in rural villages in Rajasthan, India. Half (or 20) of 40 purposively-selected treatment villages were randomly assigned to an ‘early’ intervention group that was offered a package of two biomass fuel ICS one year prior to the other half (the ‘late’ group). Analysis of data collected prior to the second phase of the intervention shows that adoption of ICS reached nearly 46% in the group exposed to the intervention, and that households largely held positive short-term views of the effects of these technologies. Moreover, we found evidence of both time savings and reductions in fuel use among intervention households. Consistent with the wider literature on the limitations of biomass-burning ICS, however, we failed to detect consistent effects on self-reported respiratory health. Findings were generally consistent across simple and difference-in-difference estimates of impacts, and suggest that biomass-burning ICS can deliver benefits even when they offer few improvements in health.
abstract_zh: 生物质燃烧型改良炉灶（ICS）常被视为家庭向更清洁烹饪转型过程中一种有前景的中间技术方案。本研究报告了对印度拉贾斯坦邦农村村庄中一个由碳金融支持的项目进行实验评估的结果。在40个经有目的地选取的处理村庄中，一半（即20个）被随机分配到“早期”干预组，该组比另一半（“晚期”组）提前一年获得一套两台生物质燃料改良炉灶。对第二阶段干预前收集的数据分析显示，在接受干预的群体中，改良炉灶的采用率达到近46%，并且家庭对这些技术的短期效果总体持积极看法。此外，我们发现干预家庭节省了时间，并减少了燃料使用。然而，与生物质燃烧改良炉灶有限性的更广泛文献一致，我们未能检测到对自我报告呼吸系统健康的稳定影响。无论是简单估计还是双重差分估计，结果总体一致，并表明即使生物质燃烧改良炉灶在健康改善方面作用有限，仍可带来益处。

Benefits and costs of rural sanitation interventions in Ghana
venue: Journal of Water, Sanitation and Hygiene for Development
abstract: The case for investment in water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) has been convincingly made. WASH is essential for protecting public health, is a human right and investing in it is compelling from a fiscal and economic point of view. While the estimated $114 billion per year of capital investments required to meet universal access to safely managed water and sanitation services by 2030 is often portrayed as a hefty price tag, current best estimates of benefit-to-cost ratios leave little doubt about its value. What is less clear is how to allocate resources efficiently. There is limited evidence on the cost efficiency and cost effectiveness of various policy and implementation choices. The underlying drivers of demand for (new) technologies and solutions are, for example, poorly understood, as is beneficiaries' willingness to pay (WTP), leading to open questions about pricing policies and sustainable business models. This is in contrast to other infrastructure sectors, such as energy and transport, where active literature on the economics and financing of services has been more helpful in defining national and international policy. Our objective with this book is to encourage the WASH sector to follow suit and start to effectively engage and research these issues. At the heart of this book therefore, are chapters which highlight some of the specificities, and challenges of conducting full economic evaluations of WASH interventions, provide a deeper understanding of potential solutions, and present new findings on costs and outcome measures, thereby contributing towards a fuller picture of WASH cost-effectiveness. In Focus–a book series that showcases the latest accomplishments in water research. Each book focuses on a specialist area with papers from top experts in the field. It aims to be a vehicle for in-depth understanding and inspire further conversations in the sector.
abstract_zh: 投资于水、环境卫生与个人卫生（WASH）的必要性已得到令人信服的论证。WASH对保护公众健康至关重要，是一项人权，而从财政和经济角度看，对其进行投资也具有充分的理由。尽管要在2030年前实现安全管理的饮用水和卫生服务的普遍覆盖，每年约需1,140亿美元的资本投资，这一数字常被描绘为一个高昂的代价，但当前对效益—成本比的最佳估计表明，其价值无可置疑。不太清楚的是如何高效地分配资源。关于各类政策和实施选择的成本效率与成本效果，证据十分有限。例如，人们对（新）技术与解决方案需求的潜在驱动因素了解甚少，受益人的支付意愿（WTP）亦是如此，这引发了关于定价政策和可持续商业模式的悬而未决的问题。相比之下，在能源和交通等其他基础设施领域，关于服务经济学与融资的活跃文献已对国家和国际政策的制定提供了较大帮助。本书的目标是鼓励WASH领域效仿，积极投入并研究这些问题。本书的核心是若干章节，它们重点阐述了开展WASH干预全面经济评估的特殊性与挑战，深入探讨了潜在解决方案，并呈现了关于成本和结果指标的新发现，从而有助于更全面地认识WASH的成本效果。《In Focus》是一套书籍系列，展示水资源研究的最新成果。每本书聚焦一个专门领域，汇集该领域顶尖专家的论文。该系列旨在成为深入理解的载体，并激发行业内的进一步交流。

Climate implications of electrification projects in the developing world: A systematic review
abstract: Energy is crucial to household health and consumption needs, and for enabling productive uses that enhance development. Yet increasing energy use also affects climate change. While ‘off-grid’ renewable solutions offer the possibility of climate-sensitive development, some argue that a low emissions energy pathway conflicts with economic development. This systematic review analyzes the state of knowledge concerning the surprisingly understudied nexus of climate and development implications of electrification projects in low- and middle-income countries, focusing on whether and how these two potentially conflicting objectives can be balanced. After systematically identifying and coding the relevant literature, we describe the relationships between generation technologies, energy services, emissions, and development outcomes therein. Despite the increasing importance of this topic, relevant literature is scant, and largely supports the idea that the development impacts from off-grid, low-emissions renewables have been muted in the past, relative to high-emissions grid-based electrification. Our results hint at the fact that more sustainable long term development will inevitably require supporting poor countries in their efforts to develop high-quality electricity grids that are more reliant on low carbon technologies.
abstract_zh: 能源对家庭健康和消费需求至关重要，也是促进生产性用途、推动发展的关键。然而，能源使用的增加也会影响气候变化。尽管“离网”可再生能源解决方案为具有气候敏感性的发展提供了可能，但也有人认为，低排放的能源路径与经济发展相冲突。本系统综述分析了低收入和中等收入国家电气化项目在气候与发展方面的影响，这一关联性尽管十分重要却研究甚少；综述聚焦于这两个可能相互冲突的目标能否以及如何得以平衡。在系统地识别并编码相关文献之后，我们描述了其中发电技术、能源服务、排放与发展成果之间的关系。尽管这一主题日益重要，相关文献却十分稀少，并且主要支持这样一种观点：与高排放的电网电气化相比，离网低排放可再生能源的发展影响在过去较为有限。我们的结果表明，更加可持续的长期发展将不可避免地需要支持贫穷国家建设高质量的电网，并使其更多地依赖低碳技术。

title: Evidence-based Policy Analysis? The Strange Case of the Randomized Controlled Trials of Community-Led Total Sanitation
abstract: Our purpose in this paper is to review the findings of 14 randomized controlled trials (RCTs) of community-led total sanitation (CLTS) and recent rural sanitation interventions to assess their usefulness and implications for sanitation policy-making in low- and middle-income countries. The results of the RCT research programme to evaluate CLTS and related sanitation interventions suggest that the magnitude of the treatment effects was much smaller and uncertain than proponents once anticipated. For example, of the ten studies that reported results for reductions in childhood diarrhoea, only three found statistically significant decreases. Surprisingly, the RCT research teams and their funders do not seem to have thought about how their multi-million dollar research agenda would support decision-making on sanitation. Information on the parameters needed for cost-effectiveness analysis or benefit–cost analysis was not collected. However, making reasonable assumptions about the missing information on parameter values, we show that cost–benefit analysis may still ‘save’ CLTS because small treatment effects may still yield net positive economic benefits if the costs of implementing CLTS programmes are modest. We also discuss the need to move beyond the desire for sanitation policies that are proven to be effective globally, and the importance of focusing on analysis of the local sanitation situation. We describe the data needed to make this shift in policy focus from the global to the local level and stress the importance of interdisciplinary communication between the proponents of RCTs and ‘evidence-based policy’, and economists who will be responsible for the economic analysis of investments in CLTS and other sanitation interventions. We also argue that the results of these RCTs highlight the importance of coordinating investments in piped water and sanitation with investments in improved housing.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在回顾14项社区主导的全面卫生设施改善（CLTS）及近期农村卫生设施干预的随机对照试验（RCT）的结果，以评估其对低收入和中等收入国家卫生政策制定的实用性与启示。针对CLTS及相关卫生干预的RCT研究结果表明，其处理效应的幅度远小于支持者先前的预期，且具有较大的不确定性。例如，在报告儿童腹泻减少结果的十项研究中，只有三项发现了统计上显著的下降。令人惊讶的是，RCT研究团队及其资助方似乎并未考虑其耗资数百万美元的研究议程将如何支持卫生决策。成本效果分析或效益—成本分析所需的参数信息并未被收集。然而，通过对缺失的参数值作出合理假设，我们表明，即使处理效应很小，只要CLTS项目的实施成本适中，成本收益分析仍可能“证明”CLTS是值得的，因为较小的处理效应仍可能带来正的净经济效益。我们还讨论了超越“全球范围内已被证明有效的卫生政策”这一诉求的必要性，以及聚焦于分析当地卫生状况的重要性。我们描述了推动政策焦点从全球转向地方所需的数据，并强调了RCT的倡导者、“基于证据的政策”支持者与负责CLTS及其他卫生投资经济分析的经济学家之间跨学科沟通的重要性。我们还认为，这些RCT的结果凸显了协调供水管道与卫生设施投资，以及改善住房投资的重要性。

title: Forecasts of Mortality and Economic Losses from Poor Water and Sanitation in Sub-Saharan Africa
abstract: This paper presents country-level estimates of water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH)-related mortality and the economic losses associated with poor access to water and sanitation infrastructure in sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) from 1990 to 2050. We examine the extent to which the changes that accompany economic growth will "solve" water and sanitation problems in SSA and, if so, how long it will take. Our simulations suggest that WASH-related mortality will continue to differ markedly across countries in sub-Saharan Africa. In many countries, expected economic growth alone will not be sufficient to eliminate WASH-related mortality or eliminate the economic losses associated with poor access to water and sanitation infrastructure by 2050. In other countries, WASH-related mortality will sharply decline, although the economic losses associated with the time spent collecting water are forecast to persist. Overall, our findings suggest that in a subset of countries in sub-Saharan Africa (e.g., Angola, Niger, Sierra Leone, Chad and several others), WASH-related investments will remain a priority for decades and require a long-term, sustained effort from both the international community and national governments.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了1990至2050年撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）各国因水、环境卫生与个人卫生（WASH）相关的死亡率以及因获取水和卫生基础设施不足而造成的经济损失的估计值。我们考察了伴随经济增长而来的变化在多大程度上能够“解决”该地区的水和卫生问题，如果能够，需要多长时间。我们的模拟表明，撒哈拉以南非洲各国的WASH相关死亡率将继续存在显著差异。在许多国家，仅靠预期的经济增长不足以在2050年前消除WASH相关死亡率，或消除因获取水和卫生基础设施不足而造成的经济损失。在另一些国家，WASH相关死亡率将大幅下降，但因取水耗时而产生的经济损失预计仍将持续。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，在撒哈拉以南非洲的部分国家（例如安哥拉、尼日尔、塞拉利昂、乍得等），WASH投资在未来数十年仍将是优先事项，并需要国际社会和各国政府的长期、持续努力。

venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Preference heterogeneity can influence behavior in economically significant ways, thereby influencing the effectiveness of environmental policies or interventions. We test this hypothesis in the context of efficient cooking technology in India. We use stated preference methods to first characterize household tastes for various features of a more efficient cooking technology. We then relate these typically unobserved preferences to households’ adoption decisions during an experiment that allowed them to choose between two alternatives with different features. Stated preferences help predict actual adoption: households initially classified as uninterested are less likely to purchase and use any new technology, while relative distaste for pollution is linked to selection of a cleaner technology. Because of this influence on adoption behaviors, preference heterogeneity has important implications for how environmental policies can impact various health and development outcomes.
abstract_zh: 偏好异质性会以具有经济意义的方式影响行为，从而影响环境政策或干预措施的有效性。我们在印度高效炊具技术的背景下检验这一假设。我们首先使用陈述偏好方法刻画家庭对高效炊具技术各项特征的偏好。随后，我们将这些通常不可观测的偏好与家庭在一项实验中的采用决策联系起来，该实验让家庭在两种具有不同特征的方案之间进行选择。陈述偏好有助于预测实际采用行为：最初被归类为不感兴趣的家庭购买并使用任何新技术的可能性更低，而对污染的相对厌恶则与选择更清洁技术相关。由于偏好异质性对采用行为有此影响，它对环境政策如何影响各类健康与发展结果具有重要意义。

title: Valuing water quality with adaptation: Evidence from a natural experiment in Jordan
abstract: Though water scarcity threats are increasing in severity across many regions of the world, allocation often remains inefficient — as in Jordan, the site of this study. One commonly discussed solution for increasing resource availability in water-scarce regions is the use of recycled wastewater for irrigation. Yet, despite significant potential benefits, an oft-cited concern with wastewater reuse is its potential impact on water quality. This paper examines the impact of this solution by exploiting a natural experiment arising from complementary infrastructure investments that introduced recycled wastewater to a new region of the Jordan Valley. We study farmer preferences for wastewater reuse, as well as farm adaptation and profitability. We find no evidence of negative impacts on farm revenues or costs over the short term, and observe signs of adaptation via the shifting of production toward less-salinity sensitive crops. Contingent valuation measures of the willingness to pay for reliable recycled water supply across newly treated and comparison areas indicate resistance to the expanded reuse of wastewater, however, which suggests that farmers may believe that this shift will entail more substantial long-term costs. Furthermore, the stated willingness to pay and short-term marginal productivity of water estimates appear unrelated. These results suggest the need for caution in interpreting short-term adaptation and preference responses to policies that substantially alter irrigation choices and behaviors, and point to the need for longer-term studies of wastewater reuse.
abstract_zh: 尽管世界许多地区的水资源短缺威胁日益严重，但水资源配置往往仍然低效，约旦即是本研究的案例地。在水资源稀缺地区，增加资源可得性的一种常被讨论的解决方案是将再生污水用于灌溉。然而，尽管其潜在收益显著，污水再利用常被提及的一个担忧是其对水质的潜在影响。本文利用一项自然实验考察了这一解决方案的影响。该自然实验源于配套的基础设施投资，这些投资将再生污水引入了约旦河谷的一个新地区。我们研究了农户对污水再利用的偏好、农场的适应行为以及盈利能力。我们发现，短期内并无证据表明农场收入或成本受到负面影响，并观察到农户通过将生产转向对盐分较不敏感的作物来进行适应的迹象。然而，关于可靠再生水供应的支付意愿的条件价值评估结果显示，新处理区域与对照区域的农户均对扩大污水再利用表现出抵触，这表明农户可能认为这种转变将带来更为实质性的长期成本。此外，陈述的支付意愿与短期边际水生产率估计之间似乎并无关联。这些结果表明，在解读农户对显著改变灌溉选择与行为的政策所作出的短期适应和偏好反应时需要谨慎，并指出有必要开展关于污水再利用的长期研究。

title: Experimental Evidence on Promotion of Electric and Improved Biomass Cookstoves
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Three billion people rely on traditional stoves and solid fuels. These energy use patterns exacerbate the global climate crisis (via increased carbon emissions) and forest degradation/deforestation (via daily fuelwood collection), and expose billions to toxic air pollution generated by dirty fuels. Widespread adoption of improved cookstoves (which use cleaner fuels or burn solid fuels more efficiently) may ease this “triple burden,” but recent research casts doubt on their potential, given low and slow diffusion. We challenge this pessimism based on a multiyear, three-phase field study comprising diagnosis, design, and experimental testing involving 1,000 rural Indian households. We show that demand for these improved energy technologies is high when supply chains are robust, technologies match local needs, and income and liquidity constraints are relaxed.
abstract_zh: 三十亿人依赖传统炉灶和固体燃料。这些能源使用模式加剧了全球气候危机（通过增加碳排放）和森林退化/毁林（通过每日采集柴薪），并使数十亿人暴露于劣质燃料产生的有毒空气污染之中。改良炉灶（使用更清洁的燃料或更高效地燃烧固体燃料）的广泛采用可能有助于缓解这种“三重负担”，但鉴于其扩散缓慢且规模有限，近期研究对其潜力提出了质疑。基于一项多年期、分三阶段进行的实地研究（包括诊断、设计和实验检验），我们对这种悲观看法提出挑战，该研究涉及印度1000个农村家庭。我们表明，当供应链稳健、技术符合当地需求、且收入和流动性约束得到缓解时，对这些改良能源技术的需求很高。

title: Factors Associated with Water Service Continuity for the Rural Populations of Bangladesh, Pakistan, Ethiopia, and Mozambique
abstract: Access to continuous water supply is key for improving health and economic outcomes in rural areas of low- and middle-income countries, but the factors associated with continuous water access in these areas have not been well-characterized. We surveyed 4786 households for evidence of technical, financial, institutional, social, and environmental predictors of rural water service continuity (WSC), defined as the percentage of the year that water is available from a source. Multiple imputed fractional logistic regression models that account for the survey design were used to assess operational risks to WSC for piped supply, tube wells, boreholes, springs, dug wells, and surface water for the rural populations of Bangladesh, Pakistan, Ethiopia, and Mozambique. Multivariable regressions indicate that households using multiple water sources were associated with lower WSC in Bangladesh, Pakistan, and Mozambique. However, the possibility must be considered that households may use more than one water source because services are intermittent. Water scarcity and drought were largely unassociated with WSC, suggesting that service interruptions may not be primarily due to physical water resource constraints. Consistent findings across countries may have broader relevance for meeting established targets for service availability as well as human health.
abstract_zh: 持续的供水是改善低收入和中等收入国家农村地区健康与经济状况的关键，但与这些地区持续供水相关的因素尚未得到充分刻画。我们对4786户家庭进行了调查，以获取技术、财务、制度、社会和环境因素是否可预测农村供水服务连续性（WSC）的证据，其中WSC定义为一年中水源可供使用的时间百分比。我们采用考虑了调查设计的多重插补分数逻辑回归模型，评估了孟加拉国、巴基斯坦、埃塞俄比亚和莫桑比克农村人口中，管道供水、管井、钻井、泉水、浅井和地表水各类供水方式所面临的运营风险对WSC的影响。多变量回归结果表明，在孟加拉国、巴基斯坦和莫桑比克，使用多种水源的家庭其WSC较低。然而，必须考虑到，家庭使用多种水源的原因可能正是因为服务是间歇性的。缺水与干旱在很大程度上与WSC无关，这表明服务中断可能并非主要由实际的水资源约束所致。跨国的一致性发现可能对实现既定的服务可得性目标以及人类健康目标具有更广泛的意义。

abstract: Water resources can play significant roles in development pathways for water-endowed, low-income countries like Nepal. This article describes three visions for water resource development in the Karnali and Mahakali Basins of Western Nepal: state-led development, demand-driven development and preservation of ecosystem integrity. The analysis calls attention to water use trade-offs, including those resulting from national priorities such as infrastructure-based hydropower and irrigation, from local drinking water demand, and from environmental conservation concerns. While these visions of water resources development do diverge, common trends appear, including acknowledgment of water management’s role in expanding energy access and increasing agricultural productivity.
abstract_zh: 水资源可以在拥有丰富水资源的低收入国家（如尼泊尔）的发展路径中发挥重要作用。本文描述了尼泊尔西部卡纳利流域与马哈卡利流域水资源开发的三种愿景：国家主导型发展、需求驱动型发展，以及生态系统完整性的保护。分析提请人们关注水资源利用中的权衡取舍，包括国家优先事项（如基础设施型水电和灌溉）所带来的权衡、当地饮用水需求带来的权衡，以及环境保护关切带来的权衡。尽管这些水资源开发愿景确有分歧，但也出现了一些共同趋势，包括各方都认识到水资源管理在扩大能源可及性和提高农业生产力方面的作用。

Access to Environmental Health Assets across Wealth Strata: Evidence from 41 Low- and Middle-Income Countries
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Low levels of household access to basic environmental health assets (EHAs)-including technologies such as clean cookstoves and bed nets or infrastructure such as piped water and electricity-in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) are known to contribute significantly to the global burden of disease. This low access persists despite decades of promotion of many low-cost, life-saving technologies, and is particularly pronounced among poor households. This study aims to characterize variation in access to EHAs among LMIC households as a function of wealth, as defined by ownership of various assets. METHODS: Demographic and Health Survey (DHS) data from 41 low- and middle-income countries were used to assess household-level access to the following EHAs: 1) improved water supply; 2) piped water supply; 3) improved sanitation; 4) modern cooking fuels; 5) electricity; and 6) bed nets. For comparison, we included access to mobile phones, which is considered a highly successful technology in terms of its penetration into poor households within LMICs. Ownership levels were compared across country-specific wealth quintiles constructed from household assets using bivariate analysis and multivariable linear regression models. RESULTS: Access to EHAs was low among the households in the bottom three quintiles of wealth. Access to piped water, modern cooking fuels, electricity and improved sanitation, for example, were all below 50% for households in the bottom three wealth quintiles. Access to certain EHAs such as improved water supply and bed nets increased only slowly with concomitant increases in wealth, while gaps in access to other EHAs varied to a greater degree by wealth quintile. For example, disparities in access between the richest and poorest quintiles were greatest for electricity and improved sanitation. Rural households in all wealth quintiles had much lower levels of access to EHAs, except for bed nets, relative to urban households. CONCLUSIONS: The findings of this study provide a basis for understanding how EHAs are distributed among poor households in LMICs, elucidate where inequalities in access are particularly pronounced, and point to a need for strategies that better reach the poor, if the global environmental burden of disease is to be reduced.
abstract_zh: 引言：在低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs），家庭对基本环境健康资产（EHAs）的可及水平较低，这些资产包括清洁炉灶和蚊帐等技术，或自来水和电力等基础设施，已知这种低可及性是造成全球疾病负担的重要原因。尽管数十年来一直在推广许多低成本、可挽救生命的技术，这种低可及性依然存在，且在贫困家庭中尤为突出。本研究旨在刻画低收入和中等收入国家家庭对环境健康资产的可及性如何随财富（以各类资产的拥有情况定义）而变化。方法：我们使用来自41个低收入和中等收入国家的人口与健康调查（DHS）数据，评估了家庭对以下环境健康资产的可及性：1）改善的供水；2）管道供水；3）改善的卫生设施；4）现代烹饪燃料；5）电力；6）蚊帐。作为比较，我们还纳入了移动电话的可及性，移动电话在低收入和中等收入国家贫困家庭中的普及程度被视为极为成功的技术。我们运用双变量分析和多变量线性回归模型，比较了基于家庭资产构建的各国财富五分位组之间的拥有水平。结果：在财富最低的三个五分位组中，环境健康资产的可及性普遍较低。例如，这三组家庭中，管道供水、现代烹饪燃料、电力和改善卫生设施的可及率均低于50%。某些环境健康资产（如改善的供水和蚊帐）的可及性随财富增长的提高十分缓慢，而其他资产的可及性差距则更多地随财富五分位组变化。例如，在电力和改善卫生设施方面，最富裕与最贫困五分位组之间的差距最大。农村家庭在各个财富五分位组中的环境健康资产可及水平均远低于城市家庭，但蚊帐除外。结论：本研究结果为理解环境健康资产如何在低收入和中等收入国家贫困家庭中分配提供了基础，阐明了可及性不平等尤为突出之处，并指出有必要制定能够更好地惠及贫困人口的策略，以减轻全球环境疾病负担。

title: Access to household water quality information leads to safer water: a cluster randomized controlled trial in India
abstract: Household-specific feedback on the microbiological safety of drinking water may result in changes to water management practices that reduce exposure risks. We conducted a randomized, controlled trial in India to determine if information on household drinking water quality could change behavior and improve microbiological quality as indicated by Escherichia coli counts. We randomly assigned 589 participating households to one of three arms: (1) a messaging-only arm receiving messaging on safe water management ( n = 237); (2) a standard testing arm receiving the same messaging plus laboratory E. coli testing results specific to that household’s drinking water ( n = 173); and (3) a test kit arm receiving messaging plus low-cost E. coli tests that could be used at the household’s discretion ( n = 179). Self-reported water treatment increased significantly in both the standard testing arm and the test kit arm between baseline and follow-up one month later. Mean log 10 E. coli counts per 100 mL in household stored drinking water increased in the messaging-only arm from 1.42 to 1.87, while decreasing in the standard testing arm (1.38 to 0.89, 65% relative reduction) and the test kit arm (1.08 to 0.65, 76% relative reduction). Findings indicate that household-specific water quality information can improve both behaviors and drinking water quality.
abstract_zh: 家庭饮用水微生物安全状况的专门反馈，可能促使家庭改变水管理做法，从而降低暴露风险。我们在印度开展了一项随机对照试验，以确定关于家庭饮用水质量的信息能否改变行为，并通过大肠杆菌计数来改善微生物水质。我们将589户参与家庭随机分配至三组：（1）仅接受信息组，接收关于安全用水管理的宣传（n = 237）；（2）标准检测组，接收相同的宣传，并获得针对该家庭饮用水的实验室大肠杆菌检测结果（n = 173）；（3）检测试剂盒组，接收宣传，并获得可由家庭自行决定使用的低成本大肠杆菌检测试剂盒（n = 179）。在基线与一个月后的随访之间，标准检测组和检测试剂盒组的自我报告水处理比例均显著上升。家庭储存饮用水中每100毫升的大肠杆菌对数计数（log10）在仅接受信息组中由1.42上升至1.87，而在标准检测组中由1.38下降至0.89（相对降幅65%），在检测试剂盒组中由1.08下降至0.65（相对降幅76%）。研究结果表明，关于家庭特定水质的信息既能改善行为，也能提升饮用水质量。

title: Communities coping with risks: Household water choice and environmental health in the Ethiopian Rift Valley
Preferences for forest attributes along an urbanization gradient in the national capital region of India
The Price of Purity: Willingness to pay for air and water purification technologies in Rajasthan, India
abstract: Diarrheal illnesses and acute respiratory infections are among the top causes for premature death and disability across the developing world, and adoption of various technologies for avoiding these illnesses remains extremely low. We exploit data from a unique contingent valuation experiment to consider whether households in rural Rajasthan are unwilling to make investments in "domain-specific" environmental health technologies when faced with health risks in multiple domains. Results indicate that demand for water-related risk reductions is higher on average than demand for air-related risk reduction. In addition, households' private health benefits from mitigating diarrheal (respiratory) disease risks are higher (no different) when community-level air pollution risks, rather than community-level water pollution risks, have previously been mitigated. This asymmetric response cannot fully be explained by survey order effects or embedding, but rather suggests that that the broader health environment and the salience of particular risks may be important in households' decision to adopt environmental health technologies.
abstract_zh: 腹泻疾病和急性呼吸道感染是发展中国家过早死亡和残疾的主要原因之一，而采用各种避免这些疾病的技术的比例仍然极低。我们利用一项独特的条件价值评估实验的数据，考察在面对多个领域的健康风险时，拉贾斯坦邦农村家庭是否不愿对“领域特定型”环境健康技术进行投资。结果表明，平均而言，对降低与水相关风险的需求高于对降低与空气相关风险的需求。此外，当社区层面的空气污染风险而非社区层面的水污染风险先前已得到缓解时，家庭从减轻腹泻（呼吸道）疾病风险中获得的私人健康效益更高（无差异）。这种不对称反应不能完全用问卷顺序效应或嵌入效应来解释，而是表明，更广泛的健康环境以及特定风险的显著性，可能在家庭采用环境健康技术的决策中具有重要作用。

title: The need for policies to reduce the costs of cleaner cooking in low income settings: Implications from systematic analysis of costs and benefits
Do Increasing Block Tariffs promote water conservation? Evidence from a unique pricing reform in Hangzhou, China
Adoption and use of a semi-gasifier cooking and water heating stove and fuel intervention in the Tibetan Plateau, China
abstract: Improved cookstoves and fuels, such as advanced gasifier stoves, carry the promise of improving health outcomes, preserving local environments, and reducing climate-forcing air pollutants. However, low adoption and use of these stoves in many settings has limited their benefits. We aimed to improve the understanding of improved stove use by describing the patterns and predictors of adoption of a semi-gasifier stove and processed biomass fuel intervention in southwestern China. Of 113 intervention homes interviewed, 79% of homes tried the stove, and the majority of these (92%) continued using it 5–10 months later. One to five months after intervention, the average proportion of days that the semi-gasifier stove was in use was modest (40.4% [95% CI 34.3–46.6]), and further declined over 13 months. Homes that received the stove in the first batch used it more frequently (67.2% [95% CI 42.1−92.3] days in use) than homes that received it in the second batch (29.3% [95% CI 13.8−44.5] days in use), likely because of stove quality and user training. Household stove use was positively associated with reported cooking needs and negatively associated with age of the main cook, household socioeconomic status, and the availability of substitute cleaner-burning stoves. Our results show that even a carefully engineered, multi-purpose semi-gasifier stove and fuel intervention contributed modestly to overall household energy use in rural China.
abstract_zh: 改良炉灶和燃料（如先进的气化炉灶）具有改善健康结果、保护当地环境和减少气候强迫性空气污染物的潜力。然而，这些炉灶在许多地方的采用率和使用率较低，限制了其效益。我们旨在通过描述中国西南部半气化炉灶和加工生物质燃料干预措施的采用模式及其预测因素，增进对改良炉灶使用情况的理解。在接受访谈的113户干预家庭中，79%的家庭试用了该炉灶，其中大多数家庭（92%）在5至10个月后仍继续使用。干预后1至5个月，半气化炉灶的平均使用天数比例不高（40.4%，95% CI 34.3–46.6），并且在13个月内进一步下降。第一批获得炉灶的家庭比第二批获得炉灶的家庭使用更为频繁（使用天数比例分别为67.2%，95% CI 42.1–92.3，以及29.3%，95% CI 13.8–44.5），这很可能是由于炉灶质量和用户培训的差异。家庭炉灶使用与报告的烹饪需求呈正相关，与主要炊事者的年龄、家庭社会经济地位以及替代性更清洁燃烧炉灶的可得性呈负相关。我们的结果表明，即使是经过精心工程设计、多用途的半气化炉灶和燃料干预，对中国农村家庭的总体能源使用也只有适度的贡献。

title: Can economic incentives enhance adoption and sustained use of a household energy technology? Evidence from a pilot study in Cambodia
abstract: While much work has examined approaches to increase uptake of a variety of household environmental, health and energy technologies, researchers and policymakers alike have struggled to ensure long-term use. Drawing on a pilot-scale experiment conducted in rural Cambodia, this study evaluates whether economic incentives enhance continued use of—and fuel savings from—improved cookstoves (ICS). Capital-cost subsidies that have been traditionally employed to enhance ICS adoption were augmented with rebates linked to stated and objectively measured use in order to investigate impacts on both initial and sustained adoption in the treatment group. Results show that households do respond to these rebates by adopting the intervention ICS at significantly higher rates, and by using it more frequently and for longer periods. Consistent with these stove-use patterns, solid-fuel use and time spent collecting or preparing fuels also decline. However, this effect appears to diminish over time. Thus, while economic inducements may significantly increase adoption and use of new environmental health technologies, corresponding reductions in environmental or livelihood burdens are not guaranteed. Additional research on the design and implementation of incentive-based interventions targeting households directly—such as carbon financing or other forms of results-based financing (RBF) for improved cookstoves—therefore seems warranted prior to wider implementation of such solutions.
abstract_zh: 尽管已有大量研究探讨了如何提高各类家庭环境、健康与能源技术的使用率，但研究人员和政策制定者在确保长期使用方面都面临困难。基于在柬埔寨农村开展的一项小规模试点实验，本研究评估了经济激励能否促进改良炉灶（ICS）的持续使用及由此带来的燃料节约。传统上用于促进ICS采纳的购置成本补贴，被与依据自述使用情况和客观测量使用情况发放的返还相结合，以考察其对处理组家庭初始采纳和持续采纳的影响。结果显示，家庭确实会对这些返还作出反应，采纳干预用ICS的比例显著提高，且使用频率更高、持续时间更长。与炉灶使用模式相一致，固体燃料的使用以及收集或准备燃料所花费的时间也有所下降。然而，这一效果似乎随时间推移而减弱。因此，尽管经济诱因可能显著提高新型环境健康技术的采纳与使用，但环境或生计负担的相应减轻并不能得到保证。因此，在更广泛地实施此类解决方案之前，有必要对直接针对家庭的激励型干预的设计与实施开展进一步研究，例如碳融资或改良炉灶的其他形式的结果导向型融资（RBF）。

title: A matter of good taste: Investigating preferences for in-house water treatment
abstract: Low demand for safe water may partly result from a perceived distaste towards or the inconvenience of treatment methods. This paper analyzes preferences for water quality improvements in peri-urban Phnom Penh. The authors first analyze data from a discrete choice experiment in which respondents selected their preferred alternative from generic options varying in cost, taste acceptability, effectiveness against diarrhea and quantity of water treated. The choice patterns suggest that demand for water treatment is highly dependent on taste acceptability. The authors also use double-blinded taste tests to show that respondents are sensitive to one common taste in treated drinking water, that stemming from chlorine disinfection. While many compounds (natural and anthropogenic) may contribute to taste problems in drinking water, the lack of alignment between household preferences for taste and water safety may play a role in the low use of household water treatment methods in many settings.
abstract_zh: 安全饮用水的需求较低，部分原因可能在于人们对处理方法的口感感到反感，或认为其使用不便。本文分析了金边近郊地区人们对水质改善的偏好。作者首先分析了一项离散选择实验的数据，受访者在该实验中从一般性的选项中选择其偏好方案，这些选项在成本、口感可接受性、对腹泻的防治效果以及处理水量等方面有所不同。选择结果表明，对水处理的需求在很大程度上取决于口感的可接受性。作者还进行了双盲口感测试，结果显示，受访者对经处理饮用水中一种常见的味道较为敏感，该味道源自氯消毒。虽然许多化合物（天然的和人为的）都可能导致饮用水的口感问题，但家庭对口感的偏好与对水安全的关注之间缺乏一致性，这可能是许多地区家庭水处理方法使用率低的原因之一。

title: How does the Rogun Dam affect water and energy scarcity in Central Asia?
abstract: The construction of the Rogun Dam in the Amu Darya Basin to increase upstream energy generation creates potential trade-offs with existing downstream irrigation, due to the different timing of energy and irrigation water demands. The present analysis, based on a hydro-economic optimization model, shows that cooperative basin-wide maximization of benefits would lead to large increases in upstream hydropower production and only minor changes in downstream irrigation benefits. However, if upstream stations, including Rogun, are managed unilaterally to maximize energy production, hydropower benefits might more than double while irrigation benefits greatly decrease, thereby substantially reducing overall basin benefits.
abstract_zh: 为增加上游发电量而在阿姆河流域修建的罗贡大坝，由于能源需求与灌溉用水需求的时间不同，可能与现有下游灌溉产生权衡取舍。本分析基于一个水文经济优化模型，结果表明，流域范围内的效益最大化合作将使上游水电产量大幅提高，而下游灌溉效益仅发生较小变化。然而，若包括罗贡在内的上游水电站各自为政，以最大化发电量为目标进行管理，水电效益可能增加一倍以上，而灌溉效益则会大幅下降，从而显著降低整个流域的总体效益。

Preferences for improved cookstoves: Evidence from rural villages in north India
abstract: Because emissions from solid fuel burning in traditional stoves impact global climate change, the regional environment, and household health, there is today real interest in improved cook stoves (ICS). Nonetheless, surprisingly little is known about what households like about these energy products. We report on preferences for biomass-burning ICS attributes in a large sample of 2120 rural households in north India, a global hotspot for biomass fuel use and the damages that such use entails. Households have a strong baseline reliance and preference for traditional stoves, a preference that outweighs the $10 and $5 willingness to pay (WTP) for realistic (33%) reductions in smoke emissions and fuel needs on average, respectively. Preferences for stove attributes are also highly varied, and correlated with a number of household characteristics (e.g. expenditures, gender of household head, patience and risk preferences). These results suggest that households exhibit cautious interest in some aspects of ICS, but that widespread adoption is unlikely because many households appear to prefer traditional stoves over ICS with similar characteristics. The policy community must therefore support a reinvigorated supply chain with complementary infrastructure investments, foster experimentation with products, encourage continued applied research and knowledge generation, and provide appropriate incentives to consumers, if ICS distribution is to be scaled up.
abstract_zh: 由于传统炉灶中固体燃料燃烧所产生的排放会影响全球气候变化、区域环境和家庭健康，如今人们对改良炉灶（ICS）产生了切实的兴趣。然而，令人惊讶的是，人们对家庭究竟喜欢这些能源产品的哪些方面所知甚少。我们报告了印度北部2120户农村家庭大样本中对生物质燃烧型改良炉灶属性的偏好，该地区是生物质燃料使用及其所带来损害的全球热点地区。家庭对传统炉灶有很强的基线依赖和偏好，这一偏好超过了平均而言为实现现实的（33%）烟雾排放和燃料需求减少而愿意支付的10美元和5美元的支付意愿（WTP）。家庭对炉灶属性的偏好也差异很大，并与若干家庭特征（如支出、户主性别、耐心和风险偏好）相关。这些结果表明，家庭对改良炉灶的某些方面表现出谨慎的兴趣，但由于许多家庭似乎更偏好传统炉灶，而非具有类似特征的改良炉灶，因此广泛采用不太可能实现。因此，如果要扩大改良炉灶的分发规模，政策界必须支持重振供应链并辅以互补的基础设施投资，促进产品试验，鼓励持续的应用研究和知识生成，并为消费者提供适当的激励。

title: Social capital, trust, and adaptation to climate change: Evidence from rural Ethiopia
The economics of household air pollution
abstract: Traditional energy technologies and consumer products contribute to household well-being in diverse ways but also often harm household air quality. We review the problem of household air pollution at a global scale, focusing particularly on the harmful effects of traditional cooking and heating. Drawing on the theory of household production, we illustrate the ambiguous relationship between household well-being and adoption of behaviors and technologies that reduce air pollution. We then review how the theory relates to the seemingly contradictory findings emerging from the literature on developing country household demand for clean fuels and stoves. In conclusion, we describe an economics research agenda to close the knowledge gaps so that policies and programs can be designed and evaluated to solve the global household air pollution problem.
abstract_zh: 传统能源技术和消费品以多种方式促进家庭福祉，但往往也损害家庭空气质量。我们在全球范围内回顾了家庭空气污染问题，尤其关注传统烹饪和取暖的有害影响。借鉴家庭生产理论，我们说明了家庭福祉与采用减少空气污染的行为和技术之间模糊的关系。随后，我们回顾了该理论如何与发展中国家家庭对清洁燃料和炉灶需求的文献中出现的看似矛盾的发现相联系。最后，我们描述了一项经济学研究议程，以填补知识空白，从而能够设计和评估政策与项目，解决全球家庭空气污染问题。

title: Fluoride exposure from groundwater as reflected by urinary fluoride and children's dental fluorosis in the Main Ethiopian Rift Valley
How do people in rural India perceive improved stoves and clean fuel? Evidence from Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand
venue: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health
abstract: Improved cook stoves (ICS) have been widely touted for their potential to deliver the triple benefits of improved household health and time savings, reduced deforestation and local environmental degradation, and reduced emissions of black carbon, a significant short-term contributor to global climate change. Yet diffusion of ICS technologies among potential users in many low-income settings, including India, remains slow, despite decades of promotion. This paper explores the variation in perceptions of and preferences for ICS in Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand, as revealed through a series of semi-structured focus groups and interviews from 11 rural villages or hamlets. We find cautious interest in new ICS technologies, and observe that preferences for ICS are positively related to perceptions of health and time savings. Other respondent and community characteristics, e.g., gender, education, prior experience with clean stoves and institutions promoting similar technologies, and social norms as perceived through the actions of neighbours, also appear important. Though they cannot be considered representative, our results suggest that efforts to increase adoption and use of ICS in rural India will likely require a combination of supply-chain improvements and carefully designed social marketing and promotion campaigns, and possibly incentives, to reduce the up-front cost of stoves.
abstract_zh: 改良炉灶（ICS）因其有望同时带来三重效益而受到广泛推崇：改善家庭健康并节省时间、减少毁林和当地环境退化，以及减少黑碳排放（黑碳是全球气候变化中一个显著的短期促成因素）。然而，尽管经过了数十年的推广，包括印度在内的许多低收入地区，潜在用户中改良炉灶技术的扩散仍然缓慢。本文通过在北方邦（Uttar Pradesh）和北阿坎德邦（Uttarakhand）11个农村村庄或村落开展的一系列半结构化焦点小组讨论和访谈，探讨了人们对改良炉灶的认知和偏好的差异。我们发现人们对新型改良炉灶技术持谨慎的兴趣，并观察到对改良炉灶的偏好与对健康和节省时间的认知呈正相关。其他受访者和社区特征，例如性别、教育程度、以往使用清洁炉灶的经验、推广类似技术的机构，以及通过邻居行为所感知到的社会规范，似乎也很重要。尽管这些结果不具有代表性，但它们表明，要在印度农村提高改良炉灶的采用和使用率，很可能需要综合运用供应链改善、精心设计的社会营销与宣传运动，并可能需要激励措施，以降低炉灶的前期成本。

title: Hydropower and irrigation in the Nam Ngum sub-basin of the Mekong River: An example of complimentary developments
Piloting improved cookstoves in India
abstract: Despite the potential of improved cookstoves to reduce the adverse environmental and health impacts of solid fuel use, their adoption and use remains low. Social marketing-with its focus on the marketing mix of promotion, product, price, and place-offers a useful way to understand household behaviors and design campaigns to change biomass fuel use. We report on a series of pilots across 3 Indian states that use different combinations of the marketing mix. We find sales varying from 0% to 60%. Behavior change promotion that combined door-to-door personalized demonstrations with information pamphlets was effective. When given a choice amongst products, households strongly preferred an electric stove over improved biomass-burning options. Among different stove attributes, reduced cooking time was considered most valuable by those adopting a new stove. Households clearly identified price as a significant barrier to adoption, while provision of discounts (e.g., rebates given if households used the stove) or payments in installments were related to higher purchase. Place-based factors such as remoteness and nongovernmental organization operations significantly affected the ability to supply and convince households to buy and use improved cookstoves. Collectively, these pilots point to the importance of continued and extensive testing of messages, pricing models, and different stove types before scale-up. Thus, we caution that a one-size-fits-all approach will not boost improved cookstove adoption.
abstract_zh: 尽管改良炉灶有潜力减少固体燃料使用对环境和健康的不利影响，但其采用率和使用率仍然很低。社会营销以促销、产品、价格和渠道（place）的营销组合为重点，为理解家庭行为和设计改变生物质燃料使用的运动提供了一种有益的途径。我们报告了在印度3个邦开展的一系列试点，这些试点采用了不同的营销组合。我们发现销售量从0%到60%不等。将挨家挨户的个性化演示与信息宣传册相结合的行为改变宣传是有效的。在可在多种产品间选择时，家庭强烈偏好电炉，而不是改良的生物质燃烧方案。在各种炉灶属性中，采用新炉灶的家庭认为缩短烹饪时间最有价值。家庭明确将价格视为采用的重要障碍，而提供折扣（例如，若家庭使用该炉灶则给予返还）或分期付款与更高的购买率相关。偏远程度和非政府组织运作等地方性因素，显著影响了供应改良炉灶以及说服家庭购买和使用的能力。总体而言，这些试点表明，在大规模推广之前，持续、广泛地测试宣传信息、定价模式和不同炉灶类型十分重要。因此，我们提醒，“一刀切”的做法无法提升改良炉灶的采用率。

Water Resources Planning under Climate Change: Assessing the Robustness of Real Options for the Blue Nile
abstract: This article presents a methodology for planning new water resources infrastructure investments and operating strategies in a world of climate change uncertainty. It combines a real options (e.g., options to defer, expand, contract, abandon, switch use, or otherwise alter a capital investment) approach with principles drawn from robust decision‐making (RDM). RDM comprises a class of methods that are used to identify investment strategies that perform relatively well, compared to the alternatives, across a wide range of plausible future scenarios. Our proposed framework relies on a simulation model that includes linkages between climate change and system hydrology, combined with sensitivity analyses that explore how economic outcomes of investments in new dams vary with forecasts of changing runoff and other uncertainties. To demonstrate the framework, we consider the case of new multipurpose dams along the Blue Nile in Ethiopia. We model flexibility in design and operating decisions—the selection, sizing, and sequencing of new dams, and reservoir operating rules. Results show that there is no single investment plan that performs best across a range of plausible future runoff conditions. The decision‐analytic framework is then used to identify dam configurations that are both robust to poor outcomes and sufficiently flexible to capture high upside benefits if favorable future climate and hydrological conditions should arise. The approach could be extended to explore design and operating features of development and adaptation projects other than dams.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在气候变化不确定性条件下规划新的水资源基础设施投资与运营策略的方法。该方法将实物期权方法（例如推迟、扩张、收缩、放弃、转换用途或以其他方式调整资本投资的期权）与稳健决策（RDM）的原则相结合。RDM是一类方法，用于识别在广泛的合理未来情景下，相较于其他备选方案表现相对较好的投资策略。我们提出的框架依赖于一个模拟模型，该模型包含气候变化与系统水文之间的联系，并结合敏感性分析，以探讨新建大坝的经济结果如何随径流预测及其他不确定性而变化。为展示该框架，我们以埃塞俄比亚尼罗河蓝尼罗河沿岸新建的多用途大坝为例。我们对设计与运营决策的灵活性进行了建模，包括新大坝的选址、规模与建设次序，以及水库运行规则。结果表明，不存在一种在各种合理未来径流条件下都表现最佳的单一投资方案。随后，该决策分析框架被用于识别这样一些大坝配置：它们既能在不利结果下保持稳健，又具有足够的灵活性，以便在有利的未来气候和水文条件出现时捕获较高的上行收益。该方法可以推广至探讨发展与适应项目中（大坝以外）的其他设计和运营特征。

title: Why 'improved' water sources are not always safe
venue: Bulletin of the World Health Organization
abstract: Existing and proposed metrics for household drinking-water services are intended to measure the availability, safety and accessibility of water sources. However, these attributes can be highly variable over time and space and this variation complicates the task of creating and implementing simple and scalable metrics. In this paper, we highlight those factors - especially those that relate to so-called improved water sources - that contribute to variability in water safety but may not be generally recognized as important by non-experts. Problems in the provision of water in adequate quantities and of adequate quality - interrelated problems that are often influenced by human behaviour - may contribute to an increased risk of poor health. Such risk may be masked by global water metrics that indicate that we are on the way to meeting the world's drinking-water needs. Given the complexity of the topic and current knowledge gaps, international metrics for access to drinking water should be interpreted with great caution. We need further targeted research on the health impacts associated with improvements in drinking-water supplies.
abstract_zh: 现有的和拟议的家庭饮用水服务指标旨在衡量水源的可得性、安全性和可及性。然而，这些属性可能随时间和空间变化很大，这种变化使得制定和实施简单且可扩展的指标变得复杂。本文重点强调了那些影响水安全变异性、但可能不为非专家所普遍认识到的因素，尤其是那些与所谓“改善水源”相关的因素。水量和水质供应方面的问题（二者相互关联，且往往受人类行为影响）可能会增加健康受损的风险。这种风险可能被全球性的水资源指标所掩盖，这些指标显示我们正在朝着满足世界饮用水需求的方向前进。鉴于该主题的复杂性以及当前的知识空白，国际上关于饮用水可及性的指标应当被极其审慎地解读。我们需要进一步开展有针对性的研究，考察饮用水供应改善所带来的健康影响。

title: Demand Assessment; Cost-Benefit and Cost-Effectiveness Analysis
venue: Book chapters in Global Water, Sanitation and Hygiene and Health

title: Economic Losses from Poor Water and Sanitation: Past, Present, and Future
venue: Book chapter in How Much have Global Problems Cost the World?
abstract: Introduction Diseases associated with poor water, sanitation, and hygiene comprise on average 6–7% of the annual mortality in less developed countries (World Health Organization 2004; Prüss-Üstün et al . 2008). A growing body of research suggests that a variety of different types of water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) interventions are effective and capable of delivering large health benefits to target populations (Hutton and Haller 2004; Fewtrell et al . 2005; Luby et al . 2005; Clasen et al . 2007; Hutton et al . 2007). Many of these interventions – the provision of improved community water supplies, point-of-use water treatment, hygiene education, on-site sanitation – can be delivered at very low cost, but their adoption remains surprisingly low (Whittington et al . 2012). Piped water and sewerage services, the gold standard for water and sanitation in the developed world, do not seem to be necessary to achieve many of the health benefits from improving existing water and sanitation conditions. Household demand for these network services, however, is much higher than for low-cost interventions, perhaps because they bring other types of improvements that households value, such as time savings and greater convenience (Whittington et al . 2009). In this chapter we present a global analysis of the “economic losses” associated with inadequate water and sanitation from 1950 to 2050. These estimates provide an entry point for thinking about the challenges of ameliorating water and sanitation services in poor countries. Using a simple simulation model, we calculate the economic losses from the morbidity and mortality associated with inadequate water and sanitation services, and from the time spent collecting water from outside the home, in less developed countries during the period 1950 to 2008. We then use projections of GDP and population growth to forecast economic losses from 2008 to 2050. We compare total economic losses with non-monetary measures of disease burden, such as deaths due to WASH-related diseases.
abstract_zh: 引言：与水、环境卫生和个人卫生不良相关的疾病，在欠发达国家平均占每年死亡人数的6–7%（世界卫生组织，2004；Prüss-Üstün等，2008）。越来越多的研究表明，各类水、环境卫生与个人卫生（WASH）干预措施是有效的，并能为目标人群带来巨大的健康效益（Hutton和Haller，2004；Fewtrell等，2005；Luby等，2005；Clasen等，2007；Hutton等，2007）。其中许多干预措施——改善社区供水、使用点水处理、卫生教育、现场卫生设施——都可以以极低的成本实施，但其采纳率仍然低得令人惊讶（Whittington等，2012）。管道供水和污水处理服务是发达国家水和卫生的黄金标准，但要实现改善现有水和卫生条件所带来的诸多健康效益，似乎并非必需。然而，家庭对这些网络服务的需求远高于对低成本干预的需求，这或许是因为它们还带来了家庭所看重的其他改善，例如节省时间和更加便利（Whittington等，2009）。在本章中，我们呈现了1950至2050年间，因水和卫生服务不足而产生的“经济损失”的全球分析。这些估计为思考如何改善贫困国家的水和卫生服务所面临的挑战提供了一个切入点。我们使用一个简单的模拟模型，计算了1950至2008年间，欠发达国家因水和卫生服务不足而导致的发病与死亡，以及因在家外取水所花费时间而产生的经济损失。随后，我们利用GDP和人口增长的预测，对2008至2050年的经济损失进行了预测。我们将总经济损失与非货币化的疾病负担指标（如因WASH相关疾病导致的死亡）进行了比较。

title: Implications of climate change for water resources development in the Ganges basin
abstract: This paper presents the first basin-wide assessment of the potential impact of climate change on the hydrology and production of the Ganges system, undertaken as part of the World Bank’s Ganges Strategic Basin Assessment. A series of modeling efforts, downscaling of climate projections, water balance calculations, hydrological simulation and economic optimization, inform the assessment. The authors find that projections of precipitation across the basin, obtained from 16 Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change-recognized General Circulation Models are highly variable, and lead to considerable differences in predictions of mean flows in the main stem of the Ganges and its tributaries. Despite uncertainties in predicted future flows, they are not, however, outside the range of natural variability in this basin, except perhaps at the tributary or sub-catchment levels. The authors also find that the hydropower potential associated with a set of 23 large dams in Nepal remains high across climate models, largely because annual flow in the tributary rivers greatly exceeds the storage capacities of these projects even in dry scenarios. The additional storage and smoothing of flows provided by these infrastructures translates into enhanced water availability in the dry season, but the relative value of this water for the purposes of irrigation in the Gangetic plain, and for low flow augmentation to Bangladesh under climate change, is unclear.
abstract_zh: 本文首次对气候变化对恒河水系水文与发电潜力的潜在影响进行了全流域范围的评估，该评估是世界银行“恒河战略流域评估”的一部分。研究综合运用了一系列建模工作，包括气候预测的降尺度、水量平衡计算、水文模拟和经济优化。作者发现，基于政府间气候变化专门委员会认可的16个大气环流模式所得出的全流域降水预测高度不确定，并导致对恒河干流及其支流平均流量的预测存在较大差异。尽管未来径流的预测存在不确定性，但除支流或子流域层面外，这些预测值并未超出该流域的自然变率范围。作者还发现，尼泊尔一组23座大型水坝的水电潜力在各气候模式下均保持较高水平，这主要是因为即使在干旱情景下，支流的年径流量也远远超过这些项目的蓄水容量。这些设施额外提供的蓄水和径流平滑作用，转化为旱季水量的增加，但在气候变化情景下，这些水对于恒河平原灌溉的相对价值，以及对孟加拉国低流量补充的价值，尚不明确。

title: Interdependence in water resource development in the Ganges: an economic analysis
abstract: It is often argued that the true benefits of water resource development in international river basins are undermined by a lack of consideration of interdependence in water resource planning. Yet it has not been adequately recognized in the water resources planning literature that overestimation of interdependence may also contribute to lack of progress in cooperation in many systems. This paper examines the nature and degree of economic interdependence in new and existing water storage projects in the Ganges River basin based on analysis conducted using the Ganges Economic Optimization Model. We find that constructing large dams on the upstream tributaries of the Ganges would have much more limited effects on controlling downstream floods than is thought and that the benefits of low-flow augmentation delivered by storage infrastructures are currently low. A better understanding of actual and prospective effects of interdependence not only changes the calculus of the benefits and costs of different scenarios of infrastructure development, but might also allow riparian countries to move closer to benefit sharing positions that are mutually acceptable.
abstract_zh: 人们常说，若水资源规划中未充分考虑相互依存性，国际河流流域水资源开发的真实效益就会被削弱。然而，水资源规划文献中尚未充分认识到，对相互依存性的高估也可能导致许多系统中合作进展的停滞。本文基于恒河经济优化模型所作的分析，考察了恒河流域新建和现有蓄水项目中经济相互依存性的性质与程度。我们发现，在恒河上游支流修建大型水坝对控制下游洪水的作用，远比人们所认为的有限，而蓄水设施提供的低流量补充效益目前也较低。对实际及潜在相互依存效应的更好理解，不仅会改变对不同基础设施开发情景的效益与成本的权衡，还可能使沿岸国家更接近彼此都能接受的利益分享立场。

title: Ten fundamental questions for water resources development in the Ganges: myths and realities
abstract: This paper summarizes the results of the Ganges Strategic Basin Assessment (SBA), a 3-year, multi-disciplinary effort undertaken by a World Bank team in cooperation with several leading regional research institutions in South Asia. It begins to fill a crucial knowledge gap, providing an initial integrated systems perspective on the major water resources planning issues facing the Ganges basin today, including some of the most important infrastructure options that have been proposed for future development. The SBA developed a set of hydrological and economic models for the Ganges system, using modern data sources and modeling techniques to assess the impact of existing and potential new hydraulic structures on flooding, hydropower, low flows, water quality and irrigation supplies at the basin scale. It also involved repeated exchanges with policymakers and opinion makers in the basin, during which perceptions of the basin could be discussed and examined. The study’s findings highlight the scale and complexity of the Ganges basin. In particular, they refute the broadly held view that upstream water storage, such as reservoirs in Nepal, can fully control basin wide flooding. In addition, the findings suggest that such dams could potentially double low flows in the dry months. The value of doing so, however, is surprisingly unclear and similar storage volumes could likely be attained through better groundwater management. Hydropower development and trade are confirmed to hold real promise (subject to rigorous project level assessment with particular attention to sediment and seismic risks) and, in the near to medium term, create few significant tradeoffs among competing water uses. Significant uncertainties, including climate change, persist, and better data would allow the models and their results to be further refined.
abstract_zh: 本文总结了恒河战略流域评估（SBA）的成果。该评估为期3年，是世界银行团队与南亚多家主要区域研究机构合作开展的多学科研究。它开始填补一个关键的知识空白，为当今恒河流域面临的主要水资源规划问题提供了初步的综合系统性视角，其中包括一些已被提议用于未来开发的最重要的基础设施方案。SBA建立了一套恒河系统的水文和经济模型，运用现代数据来源和建模技术，在流域尺度上评估现有及潜在新建水工结构对防洪、水电、低流量、水质和灌溉供水的影响。该评估还与流域内的政策制定者和舆论领袖进行了多次交流，期间对流域的各种认知得以讨论和检验。研究结论凸显了恒河流域的规模与复杂性。尤其是，研究结果驳斥了一种广泛持有的观点，即上游蓄水（例如尼泊尔的水库）可以完全控制全流域的洪水。此外，研究结果表明，此类大坝有可能使旱季的低流量翻一番。然而，这样做的价值却出人意料地不明确，而且通过更好的地下水管理，很可能也能获得相近规模的蓄水量。水电开发与贸易被证实确有真正的前景（但须以严格的项目层面评估为前提，并特别关注泥沙和地震风险），并且在中短期内，几乎不会在相互竞争的各类用水之间产生显著的权衡取舍。包括气候变化在内的重大不确定性依然存在，更好的数据将使模型及其结果能够得到进一步完善。

title: The long-term dynamics of health benefits from improved water and sanitation in developing countries
Water quality perceptions and willingness to pay for clean water in peri-urban communities in Cambodia
abstract: This paper studies household demand for improved water quality in peri-urban Cambodia, with particular attention paid to the influence of water quality on willingness to pay (WTP). Utilizing data from 915 household surveys, we analyze responses to a contingent valuation scenario using multivariate logit regression techniques that account for subjective perceptions of water quality. We estimate a mean household WTP for improved water quality of US$3 (roughly 1.2% of mean income) per month for households in this sample. We also find that the majority of households believe that their in-house water after storage, handling, and treatment is safe to drink. Furthermore, beliefs about existing levels of water quality have a significant impact on WTP for improved water quality. However, while perceptions of quality (and thus WTP) are highly related to taste preferences, actual water quality is relatively uncorrelated with water quality perceptions. These findings suggest that interventions aiming to increase the adoption of water treatment should account for underlying perceptions of water quality.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了柬埔寨城郊社区家庭对水质改善的需求，尤其关注水质认知对支付意愿（WTP）的影响。利用915份家庭调查数据，我们运用考虑了水质主观认知的多元逻辑回归方法，分析了条件价值评估情景下的回答。我们估计，该样本中家庭对水质改善的平均支付意愿为每月3美元（约占家庭平均收入的1.2%）。我们还发现，大多数家庭认为其家中经储存、处理后的饮用水是安全的。此外，对现有水质水平的看法对改善水质的支付意愿具有显著影响。然而，尽管水质认知（进而支付意愿）与口感偏好高度相关，实际水质与水质认知之间的相关性却相对较弱。这些发现表明，旨在提高水处理采纳率的干预措施应当考虑人们潜在的水质认知。

title: Water quality risks to 'improved' water sources: evidence from Cambodia
Benefits and costs of improved cookstoves: Assessing the implications of variability in health, forest and climate impacts
abstract: Current attention to improved cook stoves (ICS) focuses on the "triple benefits" they provide, in improved health and time savings for households, in preservation of forests and associated ecosystem services, and in reducing emissions that contribute to global climate change. Despite the purported economic benefits of such technologies, however, progress in achieving large-scale adoption and use has been remarkably slow. This paper uses Monte Carlo simulation analysis to evaluate the claim that households will always reap positive and large benefits from the use of such technologies. Our analysis allows for better understanding of the variability in economic costs and benefits of ICS use in developing countries, which depend on unknown combinations of numerous uncertain parameters. The model results suggest that the private net benefits of ICS will sometimes be negative, and in many instances highly so. Moreover, carbon financing and social subsidies may help enhance incentives to adopt, but will not always be appropriate. The costs and benefits of these technologies are most affected by their relative fuel costs, time and fuel use efficiencies, the incidence and cost-of-illness of acute respiratory illness, and the cost of household cooking time. Combining these results with the fact that households often find these technologies to be inconvenient or culturally inappropriate leads us to understand why uptake has been disappointing. Given the current attention to the scale up of ICS, this analysis is timely and important for highlighting some of the challenges for global efforts to promote ICS.
abstract_zh: 当前对改良炉灶（ICS）的关注集中于它们提供的“三重效益”：改善家庭健康和节省时间，保护森林及相关生态系统服务，以及减少导致全球气候变化的排放。然而，尽管这些技术据称具有经济效益，其大规模采用和使用的进展却异常缓慢。本文使用蒙特卡洛模拟分析，评估了家庭将始终从使用此类技术中获得正向且巨大收益这一主张。我们的分析有助于更好地理解发展中国家使用改良炉灶的经济成本和收益的变异性，这些成本和收益取决于众多不确定参数的未知组合。模型结果表明，改良炉灶的私人净收益有时为负，并且在许多情况下负值很大。此外，碳融资和社会补贴可能有助于增强采用的激励，但并不总是适当的。这些技术的成本和收益受其相对燃料成本、时间和燃料使用效率、急性呼吸道疾病的发病率及其疾病成本，以及家庭烹饪时间成本的影响最大。将这些结果与家庭通常认为这些技术不方便或在文化上不适宜的事实结合起来，我们便能理解为何其普及令人失望。鉴于当前对扩大改良炉灶规模的关注，本分析及时且重要，它揭示了全球推广改良炉灶努力所面临的一些挑战。

Setting Priorities and, Targeting Subsidies among Water, Sanitation, Hygiene and Preventive Health Interventions in Developing Countries
The effect of water quality testing on household behavior: Evidence from an experiment in rural India
venue: American Journal of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene
abstract: How does specific information about contamination in a household's drinking water affect water handling behavior? We randomly split a sample of households in rural Andhra Pradesh, India. The treatment group observed a contamination test of the drinking water in their own household storage vessel; while they were waiting for their results, they were also provided with a list of actions that they could take to remedy contamination if they tested positive. The control group received no test or guidance. The drinking water of nearly 90% of tested households showed evidence of contamination by fecal bacteria. They reacted by purchasing more of their water from commercial sources but not by making more time-intensive adjustments. Providing salient evidence of risk increases demand for commercial clean water.
abstract_zh: 家庭饮用水中的具体污染信息如何影响其水处理行为？我们在印度安得拉邦农村地区随机划分了一组家庭样本。处理组观察了其自家储水容器中饮用水的污染检测；在等待结果期间，他们还获得了一份行动清单，如果检测呈阳性，可以采取这些行动来补救污染。对照组既没有接受检测，也没有得到指导。在接受检测的家庭中，近90%的饮用水显示出粪便细菌污染的证据。他们的反应是从商业来源购买更多的水，而不是进行更耗费时间的调整。提供显著的风险证据会增加对商业清洁水的需求。

title: Giving stated preference respondents 'time to think': results from four countries
Economic implications of climate change for infrastructure planning in transboundary water systems: an example from the Blue Nile
abstract: This research develops a hydroeconomic modeling framework for integrating climate change impacts into the problem of planning water resources infrastructure development. It then illustrates use of that framework in evaluation of two alternative sizes of a potential hydropower project along the Blue Nile in Ethiopia. Storing water in a Blue Nile reservoir provides an interesting case for testing this integrated approach because such a project would induce a number of physical and economic changes, both transboundary and climate‐dependent. The proposed framework makes two contributions to the existing literature on water resources project appraisal. First, it demonstrates how routinely used hydrological modeling techniques can be supplemented with Monte Carlo simulation to include economic uncertainties inherent in the planning problem, in addition to its more commonly considered physical dimensions. Second, it demonstrates how analysts can include a number of linkages between climate change, hydrology, and economic production in conventional planning models to develop better understanding of the complexities and important uncertainties associated with future conditions. While the framework described here has not been used in a full analysis of alternative development projects in the Blue Nile, the general approach could be combined with a variety of decision‐analytic tools to evaluate design and management alternatives in water resources systems.
abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个水文经济建模框架，用于将气候变化影响纳入水资源基础设施开发规划问题之中。随后，该框架被用于评估埃塞俄比亚蓝尼罗河沿岸一个潜在水电项目的两种不同规模方案。在蓝尼罗河修建水库是检验这一综合方法的一个有趣案例，因为此类项目将引发一系列跨界且依赖气候的物理与经济变化。所提出的框架对现有水资源项目评估文献作出了两点贡献。第一，它展示了如何在常规使用的水文建模技术之上，辅以蒙特卡洛模拟，从而纳入规划问题中固有的经济不确定性，而不仅仅是通常考虑的物理维度。第二，它展示了分析人员如何在传统规划模型中纳入气候变化、水文与经济生产之间的若干联系，以更好地理解未来条件下的复杂性和重要不确定性。尽管本文所述框架尚未被用于对蓝尼罗河替代开发项目进行完整分析，但该总体方法可与多种决策分析工具相结合，以评估水资源系统中的设计和管理方案。

title: Sustaining the benefits of rural water supply investments: Experience from Cochabamba and Chuquisaca, Bolivia
abstract: Many rural water supply interventions in developing countries have been marked by a poor record of sustainability. Considerable progress has been made over the past several decades on the development of lower‐cost technologies that are easier for communities in developing countries to maintain and also on improving project design and implementation to enhance sustainability of outcomes. Less attention has been given to the necessary and sufficient supports for water system maintenance in the postconstruction period. This study explores the contribution of various types of postconstruction support (PCS) to the sustainability of rural water supply systems in Bolivia. Using regression and matched pair statistical analyses, the effects of PCS on water system performance and user satisfaction with service are modeled. Communities that received management‐oriented PCS visits from external agencies, and those whose system operators attended training workshops, had better performing systems than communities that received no such support. Engineering‐oriented PCS visits to communities had no measurable impact on system functioning or user satisfaction.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家的许多农村供水干预，其可持续性记录一直不佳。在过去几十年中，在开发更低成本、便于发展中国家社区维护的技术方面，以及改进项目设计与实施以增强成果可持续性方面，已取得了相当大的进展。然而，对于建成后阶段维护水系统所需的必要和充分支持，关注较少。本研究考察了多种类型的建成后支持（PCS）对玻利维亚农村供水系统可持续性的贡献。运用回归分析和配对分析等统计方法，我们对PCS对供水系统运行绩效以及用户对服务满意度的影响进行了建模。接受外部机构以管理为导向的PCS访问的社区，以及其系统运营人员参加过培训研讨会的社区，其供水系统运行状况优于未获得此类支持的社区。以工程为导向的PCS社区访问，对系统运行或用户满意度没有可测量的影响。
